method.class: Fixed-predictor bounded-mean confidence interval construction with cross-fitted regularized multi-control-variate starter
method.description: Estimate Bernoulli population prevalence E[Y] at nominal 95% using immutable labeled/unlabeled samples and fixed f(z)=z. The starter actually fits two-fold ridge polynomial inference-side transforms (f,f^2,f^3), training-fold GCV over penalties 0.0001,0.01,1 and shared-unlabeled variance using the average coefficient. This is not predictor retraining; do not add labels or samples. Exact labeled-only CP fallback is not a finite-sample validity proof for the selected composite method. Alternatives preserving this scientific scope and interface are permitted. Synthetic-only conditional investigation, including null/undercoverage outcomes, not a universal dominance or real-data claim. Plane manifests freeze analytic response functions and truths, raw normalized content, rows and independent source-generation seeds. No hidden targets or baseline outputs enter RPC. Aggregate uniform statistical seeds within each of seven cases, then weight each case 1/7. No other score hierarchy levels. Mandatory copied-input trailing diagnostic has zero independent coverage/width weight. Coverage screen is one-sided exact binomial cdf(k,S,.95)<.01/7 over a fixed seven-case family; nonrejection is not proof. Primary failure: coverage=0, width=1, ratio=1000000, utility=0; never remove or reweight. Ratio uses denominator floor 1e-12 and cap 1000000. combined_score=mean_case(mean_seed(1-width) if coverage screen passes else 0), forced to zero if plane correct is false. coverage, mean_width, width_ratio_ppiplus use the same seven-case hierarchy. control_pass_rate weights the 2*S constant/permutation checks plus copied-reset diagnostic uniformly by 1/(2*S+1). Constant control requires estimate=labeled mean within 2e-12; separate nonidentity cyclic derangements must change both prediction arrays, with loss-of-benefit assessed by paired uncertainty, never a per-run width gate. Replay compares actual estimate/endpoints within 1e-12. No state-change self-report or state hash certifies learning. Five trusted references are exact binomial, classical normal mean, actual PPI coefficient 1, actual PPI++ covariance divided by (1+n/N)*pooled prediction variance clipped to [0,1], and full-range [0,1]. PPI/PPI++ include residual and unlabeled variance; no method aliases. Uncertainty: per-case exact 95% coverage intervals; pointwise 95% paired t intervals for widths/ratios, zero-width comparators retained explicitly. Those exploratory intervals are not a simultaneous publication test. Matched C6-minus-C1 and C7-minus-C1 candidate width contrasts also have pointwise paired uncertainty; an interval spanning zero is explicitly inconclusive, not causal proof. Final distinguishes the 64 candidate RNG reset seeds (protocol.final_seeds, integers 1001 through 1064) from the unchanged 256 independent statistical/data-generation seeds (resources/final/manifest.json seeds, integers 1001 through 1256). Each statistical seed still supplies all seven cases, with identical frozen raw data, weights, baseline formulas and coverage/width uncertainty calculations. The candidate reset seed is 1001 + (statistical_seed - 1001) % 64; this deterministic initialization pool is reused across four disjoint data repetitions, never used to combine repetitions or omit data. final_reset_sequence declares every mapped reset plus the sole trailing copied-input diagnostic. Evidence records retain the statistical seed and report the corresponding reset_seed explicitly. Reusing inference RNG initialization across independent frozen data does not reuse observations or change the predictor, estimator, sample sizes, number of statistical repetitions, controls, RPC ceiling or compute limits.

protocol.promotion_rule: Harness-owned ranking only: at most three scored search invocations (three ideas, one candidate each), eligible only if search correct=true; higher combined_score wins, exact ties retain earliest eligible invocation. No comparative width/gain threshold is an eligibility gate. Search correct requires complete declared transcript, trusted data/finite scientific outputs, functioning baselines, nonvacuous required controls and reset/copy reproducibility, and nonrejection of nominal coverage in C1-C4,C6,C7. C5 remains a stress case with zero case utility if rejected, not an automatic search veto. Final correct separately certifies complete sealed experiment/evidence integrity, required controls and numerical conditional claim flags, not universal nominal validity or prose quality; honest adverse findings can satisfy final. A positive same-regime gain claim requires candidate and comparator coverage support AND paired upper width-difference bound below zero; no editing after final access. Operation table per episode: reset=1, input_with_setup<=4, infer_with_commit=1; no separate export/import operations exist. Max production search: 224 primary+1 mandatory copied-input diagnostic=225 episodes, counts 225+900+225=1350; final:1792+1=1793, counts1793+7172+1793=10758. Nominal one-chunk totals675 and5379; even a one-chunk value includes setup in input and commit in infer. Smoke:7 primary+1 mandatory copied-input diagnostic=8 episodes, max48 calls. All reset arrays include the mandatory copied-input diagnostic, not an optional broker replay; no additional optional replay is permitted. One global ordered seed-major C1-C7 transcript then copied first C1, independent of connections/restarts. reset must be first exact request. Arbitrary reset seeds initialize RNG only; n,N,alpha,shape/transport settings are explicit plane-independent input fields. No state flags or internal optimizer counters affect scientific gates. Candidate-owned memory only; total input<=4 MiB, <=4 nonoverlapping ordered raw chunks<=1 MiB, each with dtype <f8, shape, base64 encoding, total bytes/index/offset. Complete JSON UTF-8 serialization includes metadata and newline framing; preflight also encloses full RPC-like id/method/params and reserves 64 KiB+8 framing bytes. Maximum reserved message 1463879 bytes, far below 64 MiB; endpoints/acks are bounded by 16 KiB native JSON and complete 64 MiB broker limit. Mandatory max-size mock checks every call. Native subprocess uses TASK_PYTHON or sys.executable only, fresh explicit environment, no-network Landlock/seccomp, read-only single entrypoint/installed packages, candidate-owned empty cwd, no shared resource access. Production requires exact /broker-code/candidate_proxy.py AND AGENTIC_CANDIDATE_SOCKET, loads handle in evaluator process only. One monotonic deadline includes conservative startup60/120 seconds and finish30/120; each episode reserves reset .25s, candidate/each-control productive work1s, trusted baseline group .05s and kill/reap/stderr cleanup .5s. Joint worst-case planning495s and3467.4s fits600/3600; no task-required minimum productive baseline floor exists. All library threads bounded2 per role; native CPU cap ceil(1.8*2)=4 seconds per fresh episode; evaluator CPU cap wall*2. Missing/timeout episodes are not retried; remaining resets are drained with fixed failure contributions. Qualification feasible only on a completed ordinary non-smoke workload, independently of competitiveness. Smoke runs same local data loading, actual candidate update, metric/uncertainty/aggregation/output path at n32,N256 and first seed only; smoke is structural, not production throughput or scientific evidence.

Never renormalize survivors, hide failed controls, or exercise a method-name alias instead of the claimed implementation.

Report casewise nominal 95% coverage and binomial uncertainty, paired width differences/ratios and uncertainty versus exact labeled-only, classical, PPI and PPI++ references where those intervals are valid, all fixed weights/testing choices, boundary/zero-width behavior, constant/nonidentity-permutation controls and sole trailing reset replay. Nonrejection is neither coverage proof nor causal evidence.

Separate scientific validity, search eligibility/ranking and final claim assessment. Retain the three-by-one campaign ledger, deterministic ties and candidate freeze before final access. Positive shrinkage is not necessary for a scientifically complete negative result; never retrofit final publication thresholds into search eligibility.

Give the validity argument for the actual cross-fitted multi-control-variate estimator, including coefficient tuning, folds, shared unlabeled covariance and explicit assumptions/limitations. Prove stronger finite-sample assertions separately or disclaim them. Explain why inference-side transforms leave the predictor fixed, and why active labeling/cross-prediction retraining is outside scope. Compare honestly to genuine PPI++ rather than only untuned weak baselines.

Provide harness-owned wall-clock, all-thread CPU, memory and broker-call evidence covering startup, sampling, baselines, candidate updates, cancellation and cleanup. Distinguish enforced resource/RPC ceilings from advisory training_steps/folds/objective counts; untrusted candidate counters do not prove a hard internal cap. Report measured costs/unfinished work, not the task's estimated cost as a measurement.

Produce the required full paper PDF/LaTeX using the latest official edition of one chosen ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS template, that edition's page rules and required checklist. Record the chosen official release, actual template digest and terms at publication preparation. Include abstract, motivation, genuinely consulted permitted related work, method, experiments, discussion/limitations, references, full code, reproduction commands, environment/data-generation versions, seeds, measured/expected runtimes and script-to-each-table/figure mapping. Do not create publication/scaffold files during design.

Every published number/table/figure must trace to an actual reproducible run, not fabricated/placeholder evidence. Report null/adverse/failed/abandoned outcomes and synthetic-only limits. Do not identify, search for, access, infer or use the forbidden prior paper, mirrors, summaries, citing/discussing pages or code. Consult only permitted starter sources and unrelated material; immediately stop accidental prohibited exposure and later record what, where and how much in reproduction notes.

Scaffold structural validation is not completed production evidence. All statistical claim flags and paired uncertainty must be interpreted at their declared resolution; missing controls and episodes retain fixed penalties. Candidate self-reports never certify internals.

Both independent evaluators retain evaluator-owned checked per-seed cases, fixed failure contributions, baseline outputs, casewise uncertainty/comparisons, and the sole replay in evaluation_evidence.json before writing successful scalar results. The validated bounded envelope has exactly schema_version=1 and episodes; each unique signed-64-bit seed record has seed, score, correct, duration_seconds and inline solution. Final evidence remains sealed. Scheduling reserves 0.75 seconds per ordinary reset, 1.05 seconds matched total input/baseline/inference work and 0.05 seconds broker dispatch/bookkeeping (its cleanup is a no-op), plus a separately bounded 5-second first-reset startup allowance. Native paths retain 0.50 seconds process cleanup/bookkeeping plus a separate one second per episode for stderr-reader teardown; broker paths have no reader charge. Joint broker planning totals are 511.25 seconds search and 3562.05 seconds final, including external startup/finalization reserves; these are conservative allowances, not measured production receipts. Fatal transport failures retain observations and penalties, attempt the remaining declared reset-only drain, and exit nonzero after bounded cleanup. A fingerprint-bound search-smoke exposed seven ordinary broker reset read timeouts at the earlier 0.25-second bound. The revised enforced reset slot reallocates broker-only bookkeeping slack and existing plane headroom; productive work, native process cleanup, episode/RPC counts, total wall/CPU/memory ceilings and all scientific gates are unchanged. No success or full-throughput claim follows from this timing allocation.
